properties.name: peach.rocket.app-name
properties.description: 信封生产应用标识；同 namespace 格式，生产不可为 application

properties.name: peach.rocket.client
properties.description: 配置 peach.rocket 下的 client 参数；请根据实际业务含义完善中文说明。

properties.name: peach.rocket.client.access-key
properties.description: ACL 身份；与 secret-key 成对，生产必填；安全注入

properties.name: peach.rocket.client.secret-key
properties.description: ACL 密钥；禁止日志/仓库保存；生产必填

properties.name: peach.rocket.client.tls-enabled
properties.description: SDK TLS 开关；生产必须 true，仍需部署证书与信任配置

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer
properties.description: RocketMQ 消费者线程、幂等与动态注册相关参数。

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.consume-from-where
properties.description: FIRST_OFFSET 或 LAST_OFFSET；仅影响新 Group 初始位点

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.consume-thread-max
properties.description: 单 SDK Consumer 最多工作线程，不小于 min

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.consume-thread-min
properties.description: 单 SDK Consumer 最少工作线程，正数

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.dynamic-register
properties.description: 扫描并注册注解消费者；关闭后自行负责消费接入

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.enable-idempotent
properties.description: 消费 Store 去重；生产必须 true，仍需业务幂等

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.idempotent-expire
properties.description: 成功去重记录 TTL，正数；覆盖完整重放窗口

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.in-memory-max-entries
properties.description: 开发内存幂等容量，正数；生产不可依赖其持久性

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.inflight-acquire-timeout
properties.description: 消费准入等待，0–30s；超限返回重试而非 ACK

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.legacy-idempotent-key
properties.description: 旧业务 Key/Broker ID 去重模式；仅迁移，生产禁止

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.max-dynamic-consumers
properties.description: 单 JVM 动态 Consumer 上限，正数；超限启动失败

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.max-inflight
properties.description: 动态消费者共享 Handler 并发额度，正数

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.require-durable-idempotency
properties.description: 强制持久化与 owner fencing 能力；production 自动要求

properties.name: peach.rocket.consumer.shutdown-drain-timeout
properties.description: 有界排空，1ms–5m；平台宽限期还须覆盖其他关闭步骤

properties.name: peach.rocket.enabled
properties.description: 自动配置总开关；关闭后不提供 Peach 运行保障

properties.name: peach.rocket.jdbc
properties.description: 通用 JDBC Outbox/幂等存储模块的显式启用配置。

properties.name: peach.rocket.jdbc.enabled
properties.description: 可选 JDBC 自动配置；须显式引入模块、数据源、DDL

properties.name: peach.rocket.jdbc.outbox-lease
properties.description: Outbox 租约，1ms–1h 且大于默认发送超时两倍；逐条超时也受租约约束

properties.name: peach.rocket.jdbc.processing-lease
properties.description: 消费处理租约，1ms–1h；与成功记录 TTL 分开

properties.name: peach.rocket.jdbc.retention
properties.description: 无认领 SENT/FAILED 终态清理年龄，至少 1h；清理前先归档/审批 FAILED

properties.name: peach.rocket.namespace
properties.description: Peach 环境命名前缀；1–64 位 ASCII 字母/数字/下划线/点/横线，生产不可为 default

properties.name: peach.rocket.naming
properties.description: RocketMQ Topic 和消费组名称的生成规则。

properties.name: peach.rocket.naming.auto-prefix-consumer-group
properties.description: Group 增加环境与组前缀；默认保护旧位点，严格生产要求 true，须先迁移

properties.name: peach.rocket.naming.auto-prefix-env
properties.description: Topic 增加环境前缀；按最终解析名称预建 Topic

properties.name: peach.rocket.naming.group-prefix
properties.description: Group 前缀，非空；仅相应开关启用时应用

properties.name: peach.rocket.naming.topic-prefix
properties.description: Topic 前缀，非空；变更会改变路由

properties.name: peach.rocket.naming.topic-separator
properties.description: 命名分隔符，非空；变更需迁移 Topic/位点

properties.name: peach.rocket.outbox
properties.description: RocketMQ Outbox 可靠发送及本地缓存参数。

properties.name: peach.rocket.outbox.batch-size
properties.description: 每轮认领上限，启用时 1–500；结合租约和吞吐规划

properties.name: peach.rocket.outbox.enabled
properties.description: 开启 Outbox 与 Dispatcher；生产开启时要求持久化/fencing/续租能力

properties.name: peach.rocket.outbox.executor-bean-name
properties.description: 并行执行器 Bean 名，启用并行时非空；自行配置容量

properties.name: peach.rocket.outbox.in-memory-lease
properties.description: 开发内存认领租约，启用时正数

properties.name: peach.rocket.outbox.in-memory-max-entries
properties.description: 开发内存容量，启用时正数；耗尽拒绝而不删除待发记录

properties.name: peach.rocket.outbox.in-memory-max-payload-bytes
properties.description: 开发内存每条载荷预算，启用时正数

properties.name: peach.rocket.outbox.in-memory-retention
properties.description: 开发内存终态惰性清理年龄，启用时正数

properties.name: peach.rocket.outbox.parallel-enabled
properties.description: 普通 Outbox 可选并行；需要受管有界 ExecutorService

properties.name: peach.rocket.outbox.require-durable
properties.description: 强制持久化 Store；production 强制，不能静默回退内存

properties.name: peach.rocket.outbox.require-transaction
properties.description: 普通 publish 要求绑定同一数据源业务事务；production 强制

properties.name: peach.rocket.outbox.scan-interval-ms
properties.description: 扫描间隔，启用时正数；不是 Duration

properties.name: peach.rocket.producer
properties.description: RocketMQ 生产者发送与超时配置。

properties.name: peach.rocket.producer.default-timeout
properties.description: 默认发送超时，1ms–60s；单次选项显式值优先

properties.name: peach.rocket.producer.inflight-acquire-timeout
properties.description: 发送准入等待，0–30s；0 为立即拒绝

properties.name: peach.rocket.producer.max-encoding-inflight
properties.description: 并发编码/加密额度，正数；与发送额度分别限制

properties.name: peach.rocket.producer.max-header-bytes
properties.description: Header Key/Value UTF-8 总量，正数；禁止装入 secret

properties.name: peach.rocket.producer.max-header-count
properties.description: Header 项数上限，包含业务 Key；正数

properties.name: peach.rocket.producer.max-inflight
properties.description: 单 Producer 在途上限，正数；非集群限流

properties.name: peach.rocket.producer.max-payload-bytes
properties.description: 编码后信封上限，正数；必须同时满足 Broker 限制

properties.name: peach.rocket.production
properties.description: 严格模式；生产显式 true，拒绝开发降级和不支持模式

properties.name: peach.rocket.protocol
properties.description: 配置 peach.rocket 下的 protocol 参数；请根据实际业务含义完善中文说明。

properties.name: peach.rocket.protocol.max-depth
properties.description: JSON 嵌套深度，1–256；本地解析预算，不信任消息自报值

properties.name: peach.rocket.protocol.max-number-length
properties.description: JSON 数字长度，正数；避免超长数字解析资源耗尽

properties.name: peach.rocket.protocol.max-string-length
properties.description: 单个 JSON 字符串长度，正数；密文 Base64 也占字符串预算

properties.name: peach.rocket.security
properties.description: RocketMQ 消息载荷加密、密钥与安全策略配置。

properties.name: peach.rocket.security.accept-legacy-encryption
properties.description: 允许历史非 AAD 密文；仅有限迁移窗口，生产禁止

properties.name: peach.rocket.security.algorithm
properties.description: AES_GCM_AAD 或历史 AES_GCM；生产仅接受认证信封算法

properties.name: peach.rocket.security.base64-key
properties.description: true 时配置密钥为 Base64；否则按原始文本字节解释

properties.name: peach.rocket.security.enabled
properties.description: 安全 Codec 开关；生产必须 true

properties.name: peach.rocket.security.encrypt-payload
properties.description: 全业务载荷加密策略，接收端也拒绝所要求消息的明文降级；生产 true

properties.name: peach.rocket.security.encrypt-topics
properties.description: 附加按 Topic 加密策略；生产全量 encrypt-payload 不依赖此列表

properties.name: peach.rocket.security.key
properties.description: 旧单密钥，仅活动 ID 兼容；优先使用 keys 管理轮换

properties.name: peach.rocket.security.key-id
properties.description: 活动加密密钥 ID；信封携带 ID，未知 ID 拒绝

properties.name: peach.rocket.security.keys
properties.description: ID 到 AES 密钥映射；解码后应为合法 AES 长度 16/24/32 字节

properties.name: peach.rocket.topic
properties.description: RocketMQ Topic 创建、维护及队列分配配置。

properties.name: peach.rocket.topic.auto-create
properties.description: 应用启动尝试建 Topic；生产必须 false

properties.name: peach.rocket.topic.include-consumer-topics
properties.description: Topic 治理发现注解消费者声明；非 Broker 订阅权限授予

properties.name: peach.rocket.topic.include-transaction-topics
properties.description: Topic 治理发现事务处理器声明

properties.name: peach.rocket.topic.read-queue-nums
properties.description: 自动建 Topic 的读队列数，正数；生产由平台治理

properties.name: peach.rocket.topic.topics
properties.description: 额外 Topic 声明；仍需平台预建与 ACL

properties.name: peach.rocket.topic.write-queue-nums
properties.description: 自动建 Topic 的写队列数，正数；调整影响顺序路由

properties.name: peach.rocket.transaction
properties.description: RocketMQ 事务消息生产者配置。

properties.name: peach.rocket.transaction.enabled
properties.description: 事务消息自动配置开关；不同于业务事务 Outbox

properties.name: peach.rocket.transaction.producer-group
properties.description: 独立事务 Producer Group；生产启用事务消息时须显式设置非默认组名
